purpose: Test whether non-target pools add information beyond a freely temperature-calibrated terminal UMAREN market; direct market replacement is secondary.

prior_art_equivalence.crux_joint_T0_T1: done: 9h, lambda<=2023, eval 2024-25, market LL 3.343 < Harville 3.380
prior_art_equivalence.rule: T0/T1 head-to-head are anchors only; novelty is calibrated nested offset and T2 soft-fukusho

facts.model: log-linear model of trifecta market probabilities + win-odds Harville order probabilities
facts.author_caveat: author states this is not evidence of calibration or positive edge; luck contributed heavily

keiba_masters_kit.verification: README and submission README at that commit checked 2026-09-25: Apache-2.0, log-linear model, 5% blend, 4/204 hits, luck caveat, final-day 14 races, coefficient 0.9265476143601139 (reproduced 0.9265475951474501, diff 1.92e-8), Harville weight at lower bound 0, NLL 5.8988->5.8957, final balance 5,504,260pt confirmed. The 155/46 split was not located in the pages read (recorded as supplied by the Fable review).
keiba_masters_kit.position: not equivalent to EXP18: different pools, small sample, proportional de-vig, no rolling, no placebo, no terminal evaluation. Structurally an external small-sample UB1-like example on other pools. No new arm. UB1 beta is reported in Stage 1 as a reference. Its Harville coefficient 0 is not a stop reason for UB2. Weak prior-art support for placing a market temperature null. The contest reach-probability maximising policy is not transplanted to PyCaLiAI long-run growth objectives.

known.TANPUK: win/place odds time series plus pool-total votes
known.UMAREN: all unordered-pair odds time series plus pool-total votes

data.vote_rule: pool totals optional liquidity metadata only

sealed_caveat: 2024/2025 already opened for T0/T1 head-to-head; pristine only for T2 and nested offset

population.base_requirement: all starters have TANPUK win/place odds
population.target_grid_missingness: after base set, exclude as target-market settlement unavailable and report yearly

sample_space: all unordered starter pairs C(n,2), positive and normalized within race
primary_loss: race-level categorical logloss of realized unordered top2 pair

null_market.base: power-law devig m_cal proportional to (1/odds)^gamma, gamma fit <=Y-1
null_market.temperature_null: q_temp proportional to m_cal^a0, a0 fit <=Y-1
null_market.pass_rule: must beat rolling calibrated temperature null
null_market.parameterization: gamma and a0 are the same exponent; fit c0=gamma*a0 directly, or fix gamma and refit only a0; alternative c=gamma*a

primary_comparison.alternative: q_cross proportional to m_cal^a * q_LOPO^beta; a,beta fit <=Y-1
primary_comparison.collinearity_rule: center log q_LOPO and log m_cal within race; if design rank deficient or condition number>1e12, drop duplicate regressor and return q_cross=q_temp bitwise through the same code path

t2.claim: unique only under declared MaxEnt prior
t2.form: win marginals equality; penalty w_fuku*sum_i(Pq(i in top-k)-tau_i)^2; k=places(n)

power.practical_generation: v0.5: truth log p = log m_cal + eps*c, c = within-race centered (log q_T1 - log m_cal) (inside the q_cross family a=1-eps, beta=eps); true Delta = mean KL(p || best expected-logloss temperature null) on 2019-2023 formal races; n_fit(Y) synthetic outcomes on <=Y-1 formal races; fit (a,beta) with the frozen fit_cross; expected cash-inclusive Kelly growth under p on year-Y races settled at real terminal UMAREN odds; no declared independent noise
power.noise_sd: none (v0.4 declared independent per-pair noise SD=sqrt(2*Delta) abolished; estimation error = finite-sample fit error only)
power.entry_threshold: cash-inclusive Kelly on real terminal UMAREN odds (bets only where q*o exceeds the Kelly reserve); v0.4 used max(q_est/m_cal)>1/0.775 with o=0.775/m_cal
power.freeze_rule: commit numeric value to spec.json before any 2019-2023 performance; later change requires new version

superseded_invalid_economic_floor.origin: v0.4 S0-E: q_est = m_cal*exp(eps*s_true + noise), independent per-pair noise with SD(noise)=sqrt(2*Delta), odds 0.775/m_cal, entry max(q_est/m_cal)>1/0.775
superseded_invalid_economic_floor.reason_invalid: SD=sqrt(2*Delta) is the SD of a per-race logloss difference transplanted onto independent per-pair log-probability noise; it makes KL(p||q_est) about equal to KL(p||m) by construction (estimate gain ~8% of Delta, out/power_diagnostics.json), cancelling the true gain. The floor measured the convention, not the economics.
superseded_invalid_economic_floor.status: superseded_invalid_economic_floor (kept for provenance; not used for any gate)

power.takeout_note: reference only in v0.5; real terminal odds embed the actual takeout and breakage
power.growth_threshold_note: 1e-4/race is unchanged. With ~3,300 races/year it equals log-growth ~0.33/year, i.e. about +39%/year by simple conversion: a high bar.

method_v05.implementation: floor_v05.py (cache / floor / power phases); tests test_floor_v05.py -> out/floor_v05_tests.json (20/20 before floor search)
method_v05.gamma_lambda: fixed at <=2018 dry-run fits (gamma 1.0523656, lambda 0.8769143); lambda estimation error not simulated -> floor is on the optimistic (lower) side
method_v05.n_fit_rule: n_fit(Y) = number of real formal races in 2013..Y-1. <=2018 exact from the <=2018 outcome loader (jump, DNF starter-finisher, top2 dead heat excluded); 2019..Y-1 = structural eligible count x <=2018 retention (0.953304), chosen by seeded uniform subsampling (count only)
method_v05.eval_set: the same count-matched formal subset of 2019-2023 (3,170-3,175 races/year)
method_v05.sensitivity: rho = 0.5: truth tilt = eps*(0.5*c + sqrt(0.75)*v), v a fixed random direction orthogonalised within race to [1, log m_cal, log q_T1] and scaled to ||c_r||; the estimator can recover only the 0.5*c part (50% of the true log-tilt amplitude). Reference value only; never mixed with the primary floor.
method_v05.interpolation: linear between the first grid point whose rep-mean growth >= 1e-4 and the previous grid point; null if never reached
method_v05.power: at the primary floor: 400 reps; at 0.5x, 2x floor and Delta=0: 200 reps each; same rolling fits, year-stratified calendar-day bootstrap (B=1000 in simulation), year direction, LOO and grade_m1 as Stage 1; placebo conditions assumed passed (declared, compute); estimator deterministic so the seed condition follows the pooled sign
method_v05.progression_rule: Stage 1 may start only if SIGNAL power at the primary floor >= 0.80 (frozen v0.4 rule). PASS-PRACTICAL power at the floor is reported separately and is expected to be low.

stage0.structure_loader_years: 2019..2023 allowed for odds, field size, date, entropy

development.stage1_entry_condition: practical_floor_nats must be numeric and committed before any Stage1 run

hierarchy.conditional_secondary: UB3_OFFSET_U3 only if T2 roundtrip passes

placebos.P2: matched-race source time shift using TANSHO entropy cells
placebos.P4: sanity only; keep real <=Y-1 gamma,a,beta, resample Y outcomes from m_cal 200 draws
placebos.P5: constructive assert only: uniform q_LOPO must give abs(delta)<=1e-12 via collinearity code path; no draws and not Gate evidence

M1.comparison: nested cross-pool alternative minus calibrated temperature null
M1.PASS_PRACTICAL: PASS_SIGNAL and CI95 upper < -practical_floor_nats (v0.5; point estimate is not a condition)
M1.PASS_SIGNAL: same statistical conditions below practical floor
M1.PASS_PRACTICAL_v04_superseded: CI95 upper<0, practical floor, 4/5 years, 4/5 seeds, all LOO CI upper<0, P1/P2 pass, multiplicity adjusted
M1.PASS_PRACTICAL_interpretation: CI95 upper < -floor is not a condition that a true effect at the floor passes with high probability; it is a strict grade for claiming the practical floor is exceeded at 95% confidence. PASS-PRACTICAL power at the floor is computed and reported separately.
M1.sign: Delta = LL(q_cross) - LL(q_temp); improvement is negative
M1.grade_function: gate_grade.grade_m1 (single implementation used by simulation, Stage 1 and boundary tests)

M2.input: pre non-target pools plus UMAREN pre-to-terminal drift fit <=Y-1
M2.progression: only PASS_PRACTICAL can propose separate ticket experiment

prior_art.note: T0/T1 head-to-head already done (crux_joint) -> anchor only

t2_roundtrip.consequence: T2未実装で停止。UB3はStage 1のGate armから除外し、Gate armはUB2の1本(Bonferroni係数1)

power.review_item: 宣言慣習SD(noise)=sqrt(2Δ)により床が0.884 nats(全額投入参考0.255の約3.5倍、anchor差0.042の約21倍)となりPASS-PRACTICALは実質到達不能。変更は新版で

v05_changes.basis: Fable review adopted by user (2026-09-25). Only the 5 permitted items change.
v05_changes.clarifications_of_unspecified_details: stage1_protocol_v05 fixes details v0.4 left open (fit window start, lambda/gamma fitting, bootstrap B, P1/P2 mechanics, seed handling). They do not alter any v0.4 rule.

stage1_race_set_crosscheck.applied_when: at the first read of 2019-2023 outcomes in Stage 1
exclusions: DNF race: starter - finisher non-empty (starter = terminal win odds > 1.0)
top2 dead heat (not exactly one 1st and one 2nd)
stage1_race_set_crosscheck.declared_definitional_difference: EXP16A/EXP17 exclude only races without a unique winner; EXP18 also excludes 2nd-place dead heats. D = races in the reference set with a unique winner and a tied 2nd place.
stage1_race_set_crosscheck.hard_check: EXP16A set == EXP17 set, and per year EXP18 set == reference set - D exactly (race_id sets). Expected total = 15,951 - |D|.
stage1_race_set_crosscheck.on_mismatch: stop the evaluation before computing any Delta, write the differing race_ids to out/stage1_race_set_diff.json and report. Do not adjust the race set.

dnf_fix_record.bug: master_v2 has no rows for DNF horses, so counting NaN finish positions always gave 0 DNF; fixed to DNF = starter - finisher (loaders.dnf_horses) during Stage 0 (commit 3c1deb28)

anchor_before_fix.source: tool output in the Stage 0 session transcript (39ff8c26-6e3d-452e-aa10-395903a5d84c.jsonl); never committed

dnf_fix_record.note: values not saved are not estimated or reproduced

t2_future_candidate: separate future experiment only: first identify the JRA place payout formula itself from actual <=2018 fukusho payouts, then re-freeze a roundtrip. Not part of EXP18; T2 stays unimplemented, UB3 is not run, no alternative formula is tried here.

stage1_protocol_v05.fit_window: expanding 2013..Y-1 formal races for every fitted element (gamma, lambda, a0, a, beta)
stage1_protocol_v05.gamma: fit per Y by bounded 1-D max of realized-top2 loglik of devig_power(odds, gamma) on 2013..Y-1 (bounds 0.5-2.0); reported; gate models are invariant to gamma because a and a0 absorb it
stage1_protocol_v05.lambda: T1 lambda fit per Y by bounded 1-D max of realized-top2 loglik of stern_top2(pi, lambda) on 2013..Y-1 (bounds 0.3-1.5)
stage1_protocol_v05.ub1_reference: q_T0 = Harville (lambda=1); (a,beta) fit the same way; beta and UB2-UB1 reported only
stage1_protocol_v05.seeds: the estimator has no stochastic learning element; the 5-seed condition is evaluated as 5 identical runs (bitwise re-fit check); seeds_improved = 5 if pooled point < 0 else 0
stage1_protocol_v05.bootstrap: year-stratified calendar-day (YYYYMMDD) cluster bootstrap, B=10000, percentile CI95; LOO CIs with B=10000; seed 20260930
stage1_protocol_v05.P1: 200 draws: permute win-odds horse identity within every race (fit and eval years), recompute q_T1 with the real lambda_Y, refit (a,beta) rolling; placebo Delta pooled
stage1_protocol_v05.P2: 200 draws: donor race from the same venue x same starter count x terminal TANPUK win-entropy tertile (cuts from all eligible 2013-2023 races, structure only), excluding itself; donor pi assigned to recipient starters in horse-number order; singleton cells keep their own source (count reported); refit rolling
stage1_protocol_v05.placebo_pass: real Delta < 2.5% quantile of placebo Deltas (beyond the improvement-side 97.5 percentile)
stage1_protocol_v05.P4: sanity only, 200 draws: keep real <=Y-1 gamma, a0, a, beta; resample year-Y outcomes from m_cal; report mean Delta and CI-upper<0 rate; not gate evidence
stage1_protocol_v05.P5: constructive assert only: uniform q_LOPO -> collinearity path -> |Delta| <= 1e-12
secondary: U0P proportional de-vig: identical gate models by construction (power of power), reported as such
stage1_protocol_v05.material_sensitivity: only relevant if not FAIL: leave-one-venue-out CI95 uppers reported; under PASS-PRACTICAL any leave-one-venue-out CI upper >= 0 triggers stop rule 8
stage1_protocol_v05.on_pass_practical: M2 and economic-check specifics were not frozen before M1 (v0.4 requires freezing before M1 results), so EXP18 stops and reports; no M2, ROI or candidate generation in this run
